literary_fantasy.name: 회화적 컨셉아트 — 섬세한 선화 + 회화적 채색의 성인 판타지 삽화풍

versions.text:
Shared art direction (literary_fantasy v1): premium illustrated fantasy game character art.

The book brief governs facial structure, hair, silhouette, costume, palette, materials, ornament, pose, and motifs. Facial variety comes from distinctive proportions and features. The palette governs clothing, lighting, and background. Skin stays softly painted and clearly illustrated, never photoreal. Ornament density follows the brief; plain and rough materials remain appealing through texture, construction, and shading.

Combine refined, expressive linework and varied line weight with layered gouache-like color, softly blended painterly transitions, selective brushwork, and subtle paper grain. Maintain clear shapes, stylized anatomy, and tactile depth. Give paper, cloth, leather, wood, glass, and metal distinct surfaces.

Focus the sharpest detail on the face, hands, and defining costume elements. Simplify secondary detail. In form images, scenery supports her; in opened scene images, the environment may fill the frame while she remains the focal point.

Transfer only rendering language from style references; follow the book brief for identity and composition.

Avoid photographic rendering, glossy 3D, plastic skin, chibi proportions, flat cel shading, heavy impasto, and uniform texture filters.

reference.note: 그리는 방식만 옮기는 참고 그림. book-atelier-img 의 pilot/ 에 올리면 경로를 적는다

why: 얼굴 구조는 화풍이 아니라 책 설계가 정한다 — 화풍 시험 네 장의 얼굴이 닮았다
팔레트가 옷·조명·배경을 다스린다 — 같은 화풍에서 세피아(돈키호테)·라벤더(앨리스)·남색(코스모스)·잿빛(프랑켄슈타인)이 다 나왔다
장식량은 책 설계를 따른다 — 거친 재료도 그 자체로 매력 있게
피부는 칠한 느낌, 사진처럼 아님 — 프랑켄슈타인 시험컷이 반실사로 미끄러졌다
개방(명장면) 컷은 장면이 화면을 채워도 된다 — 폼 컷과 구분
머리글에 매체 문장(premium illustrated fantasy game character art)과 판 번호를 둔다
